module: Copas 2.0.2: third-party library (Kepler Project) — "Coroutine Oriented Portable Asynchronous Services", a coroutine-based dispatcher for TCP/UDP servers and clients, built on LuaSocket. Sockets are wrapped (copas.wrap) so that send/receive/connect yield instead of blocking; copas.loop or copas.step runs it all. Copas is the basis of the submodules copas.http, copas.ftp, copas.smtp, copas.timer, copas.lock, copas.semaphore and copas.limit.
usage:
local copas = require("libs/copas/copas")
copas.addthread(function()
  copas.sleep(1)
  print("1 s later")
end)
copas.loop() -- or copas.step(0) every frame
notes: In BeamNG, prefer copas.step(timeout) called periodically rather than copas.loop (endless loop that would block the game) (inferred from the nature of the functions).
copas.sleep(sleeptime) with a negative value puts the coroutine to sleep until copas.wakeup(co).
dohandshake raises an error (instead of returning nil+error) to avoid carrying on in plaintext by mistake; all references to the old socket must be replaced with the returned SSL socket.
useSocketTimeoutErrors(true) returns LuaSocket's original errors (timeout, wantread, wantwrite, Operation already in progress); otherwise always "timeout".

autoclose.desc: If true (default), closes the connection's socket once the handler has finished.

running.desc: Indicates that the copas.loop loop is running (false at the start).

addserver.desc: Registers a TCP server socket and a handler called in a new coroutine for each accepted connection (function defined in the code, not listed by the automatic extractor).

removeserver.desc: Removes a server from the dispatcher; closes it unless keep_open is true.

addthread.desc: Adds a new coroutine to the dispatcher; it starts at the next loop step.

removethread.desc: Removes a coroutine from the dispatcher (it is deleted at its next resume).

sleep.desc: Suspends the current coroutine and wakes it after sleeptime seconds. A negative value suspends it until an explicit call to wakeup.

wakeup.desc: Wakes a coroutine put to sleep by sleep.

step.desc: One step of the dispatcher loop: processes the ready sockets and the scheduled tasks.

timeout.desc: Maximum socket wait time, in seconds

returns.desc: false if no data processed, true otherwise (or nil + error message)

loop.desc: Endless dispatcher loop: listens to and processes requests until stopped. Sets copas.running to true.

initializer.desc: Function run in a coroutine at startup

finished.desc: Indicates whether there is nothing left to do (no socket for reading/writing and no scheduled task).

returns.desc: true if there is nothing left to process

wrap.desc: Wraps a LuaSocket socket into an asynchronous Copas socket; with sslt, enables SSL.

sslt.desc: SSL parameters (empty table for the defaults)

handler.desc: Wraps a handler so as to wrap the socket and perform the optional SSL handshake.

dohandshake.desc: Asynchronous SSL handshake on a connected client socket. Returns a new SSL socket that replaces the old one; raises an error on failure.

connect.desc: Connects the socket and waits (yielding) for the connection to finish.

settimeout.desc: Sets the timeout of a Copas socket.

receive.desc: Reads according to a pattern on a client and yields to timeouts. For UDP, the pattern is required and must be a number.

pattern.desc: LuaSocket read pattern ("*l", "*a", number of bytes)

receivePartial.desc: Like receive, but unblocks as soon as data arrives (partial reads).

receivefrom.desc: Receives data from a UDP client (not available for TCP).

send.desc: Sends data to a client, with buffering, yielding on timeout. from and to are ignored for UDP.

setErrorHandler.desc: Sets the function called when a handler raises an error; with default true, also replaces the default handler (inferred from code).

useSocketTimeoutErrors.desc: Chooses to return LuaSocket's original timeout errors (true) or always "timeout" (false).

_sleeping.desc: Internal queue of sleeping coroutines (internal object).

insert.desc: Inserts a sleeping coroutine (internal to the dispatcher).

remove.desc: Removes a sleeping coroutine (internal to the dispatcher).

socket.desc: LuaSocket functions redefined by Copas as coroutine-safe versions (allows using socket.http in Copas).
